metadata.question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?

data.raw_code: To answer this question, I need to: 1. Find fire detection data for Brazil in 2007 and 2019 2. Compare the number of fire detections between these years 3. Determine if 2019 had fewer fire detections than 2007 For fire detection data, I'll use: - MODIS Active Fire data (MODIS/006/MCD14ML) - this provides fire detection points - Or FIRMS data (FIRMS) - another good source for fire detections I'll need to: - Define Brazil geometry (using a simple polygon) - Filter by year for both 2007 and 2019 - Count the number of fire detections in each year - Compare the counts Potential issues: - If no fire detections in either year (C1) - If collection is empty (C1) - If calculation fails (C3) Let me use MODIS Active Fire data which is well-documented and reliable. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions brazil = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-73.9, -33.8, -34.7, 5.3]) # Brazil bounding box # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire data fire_2007 = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') \ .filterBounds(brazil) \ .filterDate('2007-01-01', '2007-12-31') fire_2019 = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') \ .filterBounds(brazil) \ .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') # Check collection sizes count_2007 = fire_2007.size().getInfo() count_2019 = fire_2019.size().getInfo() print(f"2007 Fire Detections: {count_2007}") print(f"2019 Fire Detections: {count_2019}") # Handle empty collections if count_2007 == 0 or count_2019 == 0: print("C1") else: # Compare fire counts if count_2019 < count_2007: print("A") # Yes, fewer in 2019 else: print("B") # No, not fewer in 2019 ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
brazil = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-73.9, -33.8, -34.7, 5.3])  # Brazil bounding box

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire data
fire_2007 = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') \
    .filterBounds(brazil) \
    .filterDate('2007-01-01', '2007-12-31')

fire_2019 = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') \
    .filterBounds(brazil) \
    .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31')

# Check collection sizes
count_2007 = fire_2007.size().getInfo()
count_2019 = fire_2019.size().getInfo()

print(f"2007 Fire Detections: {count_2007}")
print(f"2019 Fire Detections: {count_2019}")

# Handle empty collections
if count_2007 == 0 or count_2019 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Compare fire counts
    if count_2019 < count_2007:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")  # Yes, fewer in 2019
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")  # No, not fewer in 2019
